confidence_notes: I used web searches to check food and drink prices. The restaurant meal, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated sources: Numbeo (meal for two about EUR 51.5, inexpensive meal about EUR 10.3, beer about EUR 3.4, cappuccino about EUR 3.7), Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere and 2026 local guides (pub beer 12-18 PLN, coffee 12-18 PLN). I converted them at about 3.6 PLN and 1.10 USD per EUR, then nudged them up slightly for July peak-season and Old Town tourist pricing. The cocktail anchor is less certain. It is based on Expatistan's estimate of about 34 PLN and a guide's Old Town range of 25-45 PLN. Wine by the glass is the weakest food anchor because I found no current aggregate. It rests on an older 2024 venue menu (house wine 21 PLN) and the usual local markup over beer, giving about 22-25 PLN. I did not search for accommodation prices. Those anchors are model estimates from general knowledge for July, when demand is high because of summer tourism and St. Dominic's Fair, so they carry the most uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gdańsk prices are close to Kraków and Wrocław and slightly below Warsaw. In July, Baltic summer tourism pushes up accommodation and Old Town drink prices compared with the Polish average.
